title: recipes.json — declared review pipelines
description: The declared review pipelines a run resolves by name from .verdict/recipes.json at the PR base: lenses, synthesizer hint, and budget, compiled into the four-stage plan data.recipe and launcher.json record. The file is a review control, read from the base snapshot and hash-gated like the typed configuration, so a head edit never steers the pipeline it is judged by. Positions are declarations, not selections: run launches one process and never chooses a model. Every key is spelled exactly as published; the loader refuses any other case, an unknown key, and a duplicate key with bad-recipe.

recipes.description: One named entry per pipeline. run resolves --recipe <slug> here first; a name is a map key and never a path. The key is a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters.

recipe.description: One named pipeline: the version it declares, an optional description and budget, an optional lens set, and the required synthesizer hint.

version.description: Entry semver, recorded verbatim in data.recipe and launcher.json. A field change moves the recorded sha256, so the same document always records the same plan.

description.description: Operator prose for humans, at most 280 characters. It is never rendered into the directive: only validated ids, enums, numbers, and pattern-checked hints reach the prompt.

budget_usd.description: Declared USD budget for the whole pipeline, above zero. It is recorded and rendered, and a value above the bundle's spend.personal_limit_usd warns; run enforces nothing and never refuses on it.

lenses.description: The lens set the pipeline declares, in declaration order. Omit it to inherit the bundle's loaded lenses from lenses.txt in file order. A declared lens the bundle does not load warns and never refuses: lens offers are per plan group, and fetch is the authority on them.

synthesize.description: The synthesizer stage's model hint. The empty object is the "no hint" spelling, and it is the built-in default's whole entry besides its version.

lens.description: One declared lens: the id it selects, its model hint, and the per-lens dispatch caps the reviewer-subagent contract states.

id.description: Lens id, a lowercase slug. A missing lens warns; a repeated id in one entry refuses bad-recipe.

model.description: Model hint for this lens: at most 64 characters of letters, digits, and ._:|@+~-, so a hint can never reshape the directive. Verdict never selects a model.

max_files.description: How many changed files this lens may read, 1 to 24.

max_findings.description: How many findings this lens may return, 1 to 20.

synthesize.description: The synthesizer stage's declaration. Only a model hint is declared; dedupe and rank take none.

model.description: Synthesizer model hint, same grammar and cap as a lens hint.
